## Prior Argentina work and disjointness

Reuse and cite completed #442, #950 and #960 only for what their exact evidence supports: Argentina Northeast member-level source/semantic review, the unsimplified 2020 geoBoundaries source inventory, and the licensed Georef crosswalk. #442 records that its unsimplified source response was 69,702,323 bytes with 525 features while metadata advertised 526, and that the pinned registry hash did not match that response hash. Preserve the discrepancy and all source-date, legal-role, source-authority and reuse limits. The Georef service comparison has no confirmed layer vintage or reuse terms; do not redistribute or treat it as legal authority.

All four contact IDs occur in #442's regional location roster. The full physical-family ID and all seven exact component IDs do not occur in #442's acceptance, issue snapshot, or either merged PR's owned evidence directory (`data/regional-review/regional-review-fd433005036fe22b/`). This candidate is disjoint in physical gap work; contact reuse is a deliberate source/context dependency. #442's canonical claim is released (`active:false`). A refreshed all-state inventory found no open issue or PR containing this family, any of its seven components, or any of its four contacts. Preserve the prior packet and its conclusions; this child is limited to the exact family below.

## Contract amendment (2026-10-07)

This targeted evidence-pin amendment preserves the seven-component family, four contacts, three neighbors, owned path, source-only limits, all acceptance gates and all other baseline pins. The prior archive input pin `aaf34413713c3b75175d04b6b7cafa4910ebdca762d2637a6547024466e3e07e` is replaced by the pinned #443 source identity register (`08891ff552e397d237e63feaaea4a4ae4cad69d1d947ca74fd86b13157369347`) and packet transport inventory (`c426aa785e4282bd7c4653a3e72c6f64201afb8736675242b3c59d8ead659534`). Those records cross-bind the encoded archive identity (22,949,678 bytes, SHA-256 `aaf344…`) to the raw-source identity recorded in #442 (69,702,323 bytes, SHA-256 `f35dae…`). The decoded archive remains refused before read because it exceeds the 32 MiB file cap; it is not an admitted geometry input. The complete pre-amendment issue body and manifest/head state are retained in `research/geography/argentina-gap-source-fitness-20261007/issue-contract-before-amendment.json`.

## Acceptance

- Authenticate the current routing report, the actual containing family slice, the complete seven-member component inputs, the four current contacts, the original-source catalogue, the pinned Argentina location policy and recipe URL transform, the exact simplified product bytes, and the pinned prior source identity register plus transport inventory. Bind machine pins only to existing ordinary whole files and list each in `pin_files`; do not present virtual whole-stream digests as physical files.
- Individually account for all seven component IDs, all four contacts, all three recorded neighbors, and every original source/admin observation. Reconcile existing source-relative rows and measurements without rerunning or modifying the global physical producer. Cross-bind the prior unsimplified source’s encoded and decoded identities from the pinned source register, packet manifest, and #442 inventory. Refuse decoded source admission before reading when its recorded size exceeds the explicit 32 MiB per-file cap; do not include the oversized archive in ordinary Baseline input descriptors, decompress it, or treat it as admitted geometry. Do not trim the family to the one uniquely covered component or infer unreported source relationships.
- Compare the exact source payload consumed by the baseline recipe to #442's unsimplified source record and #960's Georef crosswalk where source bytes and terms permit. Record product completeness, feature identity, role, vintage, source locator, metadata and license separately; preserve discrepancies and inaccessible/over-limit source material as explicit limits.
- State what is and is not supported for each component/contact. Preserve unapproved source/physical authority, unknown cause, effective-date and lineage questions, unknown boundary length, surface/land-water status, physical completeness and legal ownership. No source fit conclusion approves a boundary or dry land.
- Preserve exact IDs, source bytes/hashes, neighbors, inputs, methods, results and uncertainty in the owned evidence path. Include a bounded reproduction and evidence-quality manifest tied to this issue and baseline.
- No geography or record edits, source imports, clipping, snapping, repair, simplification, fill, hierarchy changes, release, publication, or approval. One PR maximum. When this child’s acceptance is complete, the PR closes #1418 and keeps parent #1202 open; the PR summary links the parent.
